workflow_comment: The AI assisted grading workflow worked well when the learners answered and did their work correctly. When the learners work was done incorrectly, AI corrected and gave feedback following the course rubrics. The feedback is down to the point. It does not reflect or use critical thinking that would help a learner better understand. There are many Spanish speaking learners who benefit from receiving emails in Spanish with  personal feedback helping them reflect as well as using critical thinking to better understand.
